decisive_spans.text: ECG findings:  Image Title: Initial ECG  Image Description: Shows sinus rhythm with first-degree atrioventricular block (PR interval 360 ms), right bundle-branch block (RBBB) and left anterior fascicular block (LAFB). Left axis deviation and qR in leads I and aVL, and rS in leads II, III, and aVF.- 24-hour ECG monitoring:  Image Title: Continuous ambulatory ECG monitoring  Image Description: Shows sinus rhythm (average 60 beats/min), PR prolongation (360 ms) and third-degree AV block with minimum heart rate of 36 beats/min. Mobitz type I second-degree AV block with pause and junctional escape beat observed. No atrial/ventricular arrhythmia found.
